charter.purpose: Help developers change the made-up Harbour Loans demo application safely: understand the change, reuse existing code, start from sound code, and get early review feedback.
in_scope: Python Plotly Dash pages and callbacks for the Harbour Loans demo
out_of_scope: Changes to shared infrastructure or deployment settings
architecture_principles: All database access goes through db_table_functions, never straight from a page.
Pages only show data and collect input; business decisions live in agents.
Every stored time is UTC with a time zone.
constraints: Python 3.14 only, with pinned library versions.
No secrets in code, logs, or tests.
Generated code is a starting point and is always reviewed by a person.

glossary.meaning: One developer change, tracked from start to handoff.
The versioned house rules used for generation and review.
The rulebook version a request keeps until it finishes.

rules.title: Error messages are plain sentences
rules.why: Developers and Admins must understand what went wrong and how to fix it without reading a stack trace.
rules.good_example: raise ConfigError("DA_DB_PATH is empty. Set it in your .env file.")

rules.title: Store times in UTC with a time zone
rules.why: Times without a zone are read differently on different machines, which breaks ordering and reports.

rules.title: Never log or print secrets
rules.why: Log files are kept and shared widely; a key written there is a key exposed.

rules.title: Database access only through db_table_functions
rules.why: Keeping every query in one folder means a database move only touches that folder.
rules.bad_example: conn.execute("SELECT * FROM loans") inside a page callback

rules.title: Short functions with clear names
rules.why: Small, well-named functions are easier to review, test, and reuse.
rules.bad_example: def process(data): ... (200 lines doing five jobs)

rules.title: Use Dash Mantine Components for form controls
rules.why: One component set keeps every page looking and behaving the same.

rules.title: Button labels start with a verb
rules.why: A label that says what will happen avoids wrong clicks.

never_generate_zones.name: Security
never_generate_zones.description: Encryption, key handling, and permission checks are written by people only.

never_generate_zones.name: Login
never_generate_zones.description: Sign-in, sessions, and passwords are written by people only.

flag_review_zones.name: Security
flag_review_zones.description: Encryption, key handling, and permission checks.
